items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-3 covered by server tests, component tests and a real-browser E2E

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: symlink 403, ELOCKED 409, 404 not found / lead_unknown, 409 duplicate / already_countersigned

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: lead id and timestamp validated, paths via the allowlist helper, reason bounded one line, no quote text in the record; origin/CSRF limit shared with countersign and documented

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: real files, crash residue and double click simulated, both cross-action orders tested

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: audit read is whole-file per request, same accepted cost as audit-log.ts

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: all touched files under 300 lines; client mirror of decisionKeyOf by rule 7

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: audit.jsonl producer (webui) and consumer (audit view + leadwright) round-tripped in the E2E through the audit API
